## Activity

During February 2024, East City Eye Clinic completed 196 captures. Activity proceeded as scheduled, with session lists running as planned apart from routine leave. The recorded activity provides the basis for the image-quality and grading results reported below. There were no other operational exceptions identified in the available session information.

## Image quality

Of the 196 captures completed during February 2024, 2 were marked ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 1.0 per cent. The result indicates that the great majority of captured images were suitable for grading. The ungradable captures remain included in the activity total and are reported separately for monitoring purposes.

## Grading

Grading identified 54 referable results from the activity completed at East City Eye Clinic. The median lag from photograph capture to grading was 2 days. This measure reflects the midpoint of the recorded interval between image capture and completion of grading. Together, the referable results and the median lag provide a summary of grading outcomes and timeliness for February 2024. Session lists continued to run as planned apart from routine leave.
